visualCharacteristics: Two-column promo: an image on one side beside a text column (heading + paragraph + CTA button). Stacks vertically on mobile.
contentPattern: One row, two cells: one cell is an image, the other holds a heading, paragraph, and a CTA link/button.
usage: Side-by-side image + text/CTA promotional band (e.g. quiz finder, Safe Play). Use the media-right option to place the image on the right and lead with text.

options.name: media-right
options.label: Media Right
options.description: Places the image column on the right (text-first) at desktop widths.
